description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pothupitiya, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530019
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land ownership determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, extents, owner names and identities, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
